scope: Repair synchronous tool result publication, debug bank dimension consumers, recovery localization and UI event documentation. Preserve the user-selected original charging rules.
changes: Successful tool usage is counted once independently of presentation. Capture game type/id/source before submission; duplicate receipts produce no extra usage statistics or spend events.

Presentation checks page generation, session identity, round id, latest successful sequence and already presented sequence. Failed results also check the sequence at request start, so an outer failure cannot obscure a successful reentrant retry.

Publish all board changes and the committed undo history before rendering cells and emitting cell-change signals. Reentrant consumers see a complete step; older presentation cannot clear a newer hint.
New history resets highlight_cursor in the committed snapshot, preserving the original next-undo behavior after moving history publication out of incremental UI appends.
SP/LK/LK Modified bank lists, entry, navigation and win-next paths obtain dimensions from validated regionMap. SP navigation and win-next normalize validated JSON rank to the required integer type.
Reuse RECOVERY_SAVE_ERROR and FAIL_TRY_AGAIN for remaining recovery prompts. UIEvents documents supported synchronous close/reopen/destruction callbacks.
retained_product_rules: Each successful new hint request charges the configured price; applying it does not charge again.
An accepted empty locate attempt still charges and counts as usage without inventing a cat or history step.
Free policies, no available undo step behavior, save-failure rollback and no automatic tool use after ad rewards remain unchanged.

pre_fix_publication.scope: Frozen pre-fix runtime under controlled synchronous listeners; no claim of ordinary production input reproducing these cases.

save failure and synchronous successful retry
multi-cell hint publication and newer hint preservation
highlight cursor reset and subsequent undo
